entities.summary: Amalia Anglés y Mayer or Amalia Anglés y Moya or Angles Mayer de Fortuny, was a Spanish soprano opera singer and guitarist. She has been called "one of the most precocious and important singers of the 19th century in Spain." She died suddenly at 31.
